blockers.description: Phase 6 feasibility spike: NO-GO. The free-meet-completion approach for IPL<v,imp,top> conservativity is blocked. UpperSet.Ici does not preserve Heyting implication. Counterexample: in a 4-element lattice {bot,a,b,top} with a and b incomparable, UpperSet.Ici(a=>b) = UpperSet(B) but UpperSet.Ici(a) => UpperSet.Ici(b) excludes bot. Heyting implication is right-adjoint to meet, not join -- no symmetric free-completion via UpperSet exists.
alternative_approaches: MacNeille completion with explicit himp-preservation analysis
Godel-Tait translation from OrImp to ConjImp
blockers.effort_estimate: substantial (well beyond the 9.75h conservativity estimate; new mathematical infrastructure required)
